mapper.select: select count(1) as totalRabbits, coalesce(sum(case when type = '0' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as seedRabbits, coalesce(sum(case when gender = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as maleRabbits, coalesce(sum(case when gender = '0' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as femaleRabbits, coalesce(sum(case when type = '0' and gender = '0' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as femaleSeedRabbits, coalesce(sum(case when type = '2' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as commodityRabbits, coalesce(sum(case when type = '1' then 1 else 0 end), 0) as replacementRabbits from rabbits where house_id in and is_active = true

select count(distinct bc.mother_rabbit_id) from breeding_cycles bc inner join rabbits r on r.id = bc.mother_rabbit_id and r.house_id = bc.house_id where bc.house_id in and bc.closed_at is null and r.is_active = true and r.type = '0' and r.gender = '0'

select coalesce(sum(total_litters), 0) as totalLitters, coalesce(sum(total_kits), 0) as totalKits, coalesce(sum(total_live_kits), 0) as totalLiveKits, coalesce(sum(total_weaned), 0) as totalWeaned, coalesce(sum(success_breeding_count), 0) as successBreedingCount, coalesce(sum(failed_breeding_count), 0) as failedBreedingCount from breeding_performance where house_id in
select coalesce(sum(br.current_nursing_kits), 0) from batch_rabbits br join batches b on b.id = br.batch_id where b.house_id in and br.batch_role = 'breeding' and br.is_active = true

select month(birth_date) as month, coalesce(sum(live_kits), 0) as count from parturition_records where house_id in and birth_date >= #{from} and birth_date < #{to} group by month(birth_date) order by month(birth_date)

select month(weaning_date) as month, coalesce(sum(weaning_count), 0) as count from weaning_records where house_id in and weaning_date >= #{from} and weaning_date < #{to} group by month(weaning_date) order by month(weaning_date)
